trends.trendName: No itemised sublimits for cancer care
trends.whatProductOffers: Covers diagnostic tests, cancer treatments, medication, reconstructive surgery and monitoring with no itemised benefit sublimit under those four benefit categories.

keyFigures.label: Itemised sublimits
keyFigures.condition: Diagnostic, Cancer Treatment, Reconstructive Surgery and Monitoring Benefits

keyFigures.label: Covered cancer
keyFigures.value: all stages of malignant cancer and carcinoma-in-situ
keyFigures.condition: occurring more than 90 days after policy issue or commencement

exclusionsOrConditions: Covered cancer must have occurred more than 90 days after the policy is issued or commences, whichever is later.
No itemised sublimit applies only within the four named benefit categories; other benefits may still have limits.
Benefit amounts and the annual or lifetime limit are not in the extracted text.
negativeSignalPhrases: needs a cash lump sum on diagnosis
wants cover from day one of policy
clientProfileFit: Clients facing private cancer treatment costs
People with family history of cancer wanting treatment cover
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, diagnostic tests, treatment, reconstructive surgery and monitoring carry no itemised sublimits.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the benefit amounts and any annual limit in the benefit schedule.
Confirm the 90-day covered cancer condition wording.
Confirm whether reconstructive surgery requires pre-approval.
sourceEvidence: Diagnostic tests, cancer treatments, medication, reconstructive surgery and monitoring are fully covered^ to ease your financial burden

trends.notesForReviewer: Dollar limits per benefit are not in the extracted text.

trends.whatProductOffers: Provides a benefit for experimental drugs used in cancer treatment, described as a first-in-market benefit among similar cancer protection products from major Hong Kong insurers as of 1 September 2022.
exclusionsOrConditions: The first-in-market claim is a point-in-time comparison as of 1 September 2022, not a current guarantee.
The benefit amount, eligible drug list and approval process are not in the extracted text.
Experimental drugs are generally not covered by other medical products, including high-end medical plans, so this is a gap-filler rather than an alternative to a full medical plan.
negativeSignalPhrases: wants guaranteed access to any drug
needs cover for unapproved treatments abroad
clientProfileFit: Clients with late-stage cancer concerns in the family
Buyers who already hold a high-end medical plan but lack drug cover
trends.talkingPointTemplate: {client_detail} gets a benefit for experimental drugs that most medical plans exclude.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the experimental drug benefit limit and eligible drug definition.
Confirm the benefit is still described as first-in-market in current materials.
sourceEvidence: Cancer Guardian 3 offers the first-in-market benefit for experimental drug in comparison against similar cancer protection insurance products provided by major Hong Kong insurance companies as of 1 September 2022.
trends.notesForReviewer: No benefit limit or drug list in the extracted text.

trends.whatProductOffers: Reimburses HPV vaccination and cancer screening for the insured, and provides preventive cancer check-ups for up to 2 immediate family members if the insured is diagnosed with a covered cancer.

keyFigures.label: Family check-ups
keyFigures.condition: if the insured is diagnosed with a covered cancer

exclusionsOrConditions: Predictive expenses are limited to pap smear under the Prevention and Early Detection Benefits; other predictive tests are not covered.
Family member check-ups are triggered only by the insured's covered cancer diagnosis.
Amounts for vaccination and screening are not in the extracted text.
clientProfileFit: Parents wanting HPV vaccination and screening covered
trends.talkingPointTemplate: {client_detail} gets screening and HPV vaccination reimbursed, and two family members can be checked if cancer is diagnosed.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the reimbursement limit for HPV vaccination and screening.
Confirm the definition of immediate family member for the check-up benefit.
Confirm that only pap smear is covered for predictive purposes.
sourceEvidence: HPV vaccination and cancer screening to lower cancer risks and screen early-stage cancer proactively, with such expenses can be reimbursed
Preventive cancer check-ups for up to 2 immediate family members if the insured is diagnosed with a covered cancer

trends.whatProductOffers: Provides continuous protection for cancer as a chronic disease by replenishing the covered cancer limit every 3 years, addressing recurrence and long treatment periods.
exclusionsOrConditions: Replenishment applies to the covered cancer limit only; the replenished amount is not stated in the extracted text.
Covered cancer must satisfy the 90-day condition after policy issue or commencement.
The plan is a cancer plan; non-cancer chronic conditions are not covered.
clientProfileFit: Clients with strong cancer recurrence concerns
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Because cancer can recur, {client_detail}'s covered cancer limit replenishes every 3 years instead of being used up once.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the replenished amount and whether it applies after a claim or after 3 policy years.
Confirm whether recurrence is covered within the replenished limit.
sourceEvidence: Continuous protection with covered cancer limit replenishes every 3 years
Cancer is now a chronic disease with prolonged treatment and recovery periods. It also carries recurrence risk
trends.notesForReviewer: Replenished amount and mechanics not detailed in the extracted text.

trends.whatProductOffers: Offers local cashless hospitalisation, personal medical case management with rehabilitation management, and the Health Pilot service to support the insured through diagnosis, treatment and recovery.

keyFigures.label: Cashless hospitalisation
keyFigures.condition: removes upfront payment of medical bills

exclusionsOrConditions: Value-added services are not contractual, are non-guaranteed and are offered at the insurer's discretion.
Cashless service is local; overseas treatment is not cashless.
Service scope and provider list may change without notice.
clientProfileFit: Clients without cash buffer for hospital deposits
Patients needing navigation support after diagnosis
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, local hospital bills are settled cashless and a case manager coordinates treatment and rehab.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the current cashless hospital network.
Confirm that value-added services are non-contractual.
sourceEvidence: Local cashless hospitalisation to remove the hassles of paying your medical bills
Personal medical case management services with rehabilitation management to get you medical support
Value-added services are not contractual services and non-guaranteed
trends.notesForReviewer: Service details sit in a separate service leaflet, not in the extracted text.

The client needs cover for non-cancer conditions.
The client needs cover within the first 90 days of the policy.
